---
title: "CO Assessment Plan & Target Levels"
---

The CO assessment process for this course uses a combination of direct and indirect assessment methods. Direct assessment is carried out through internal evaluation (Continuous Assessment Examinations CAE & PUT) and external evaluation (AKTU End Semester Examinations). Indirect assessment is evaluated through course exit surveys, co-curricular/extracurricular activities, industrial visits, guest lectures, and alumni interactions.

### CO Assessment Tools: {{< meta coursefile.academic-session >}} {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: co-assessment-plan-table
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(knitr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Assessment data (shared across all output formats)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

assessment_df <- data.frame(
    `Course Type` = rep("Theory", 3),
    `Assessment Method` = c(
        "Direct Method (80%)",
        "Direct Method (80%)",
        "Indirect Method (20%)"
    ),
    `Components` = c(
        "Internal Assessment (30%)",
        "External Assessment (70%)",
        "—"
    ),
    `Assessment Tool` = c(
        "Continuous Assessment Examinations (CAE & PUT)",
        "AKTU End-Semester Examinations",
        paste(
            "Course Exit Survey, mapped co-curricular and",
            "extracurricular activities, industrial visits,",
            "alumni talks, guest lectures, etc."
        )
    ),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. PDF output: kableExtra
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    library(kableExtra)

    tbl <- kbl(
        assessment_df,
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        longtable = TRUE,
        align = c("c", "c", "l", "l"),
        linesep = ""
    ) |>
        kable_styling(
            latex_options = "repeat_header",
            font_size = 9,
            full_width = FALSE
        ) |>
        column_spec(1, width = "0.70in", bold = TRUE) |>
        column_spec(2, width = "1.25in") |>
        column_spec(3, width = "1.40in") |>
        column_spec(4, width = "2.20in") |>
        row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

    cat(as.character(tbl), "\n\n", sep = "")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. DOCX output: flextable
# ---------------------------------------------------------

} else if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {

    library(flextable)

    tbl <- flextable(assessment_df) |>
        merge_v(
            j = "Course Type",
            part = "body"
        ) |>
        merge_v(
            j = "Assessment Method",
            part = "body"
        ) |>
        theme_booktabs() |>
        bold(
            part = "header"
        ) |>
        bold(
            j = "Course Type",
            part = "body"
        ) |>
        align(
            j = c("Course Type", "Assessment Method"),
            align = "center",
            part = "all"
        ) |>
        valign(
            valign = "center",
            part = "body"
        ) |>
        fontsize(
            size = 9,
            part = "all"
        ) |>
        width(
            j = 1,
            width = 0.70
        ) |>
        width(
            j = 2,
            width = 1.25
        ) |>
        width(
            j = 3,
            width = 1.40
        ) |>
        width(
            j = 4,
            width = 2.20
        ) |>
        padding(
            padding = 5,
            part = "all"
        ) |>
        set_table_properties(
            layout = "fixed"
        )

    flextable::flextable_to_rmd(tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. HTML output: kableExtra
# ---------------------------------------------------------

} else if (knitr::is_html_output()) {

    library(kableExtra)

    tbl <- kbl(
        assessment_df,
        format = "html",
        align = c("c", "c", "l", "l")
    ) |>
        kable_styling(
            bootstrap_options = c(
                "bordered",
                "condensed"
            ),
            full_width = FALSE,
            position = "center"
        ) |>
        row_spec(
            0,
            bold = TRUE,
            background = "#EDF1F5"
        ) |>
        column_spec(
            1,
            width = "85px",
            bold = TRUE
        ) |>
        column_spec(
            2,
            width = "150px"
        ) |>
        column_spec(
            3,
            width = "170px"
        ) |>
        column_spec(
            4,
            width = "270px"
        ) |>
        collapse_rows(
            columns = c(1, 2),
            valign = "middle"
        )

    cat(as.character(tbl), "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```



### Attainment Level for Direct Method of Assessment {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: direct-attainment-levels-table
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(knitr)

# Local table renderer: no dependency on _data_helpers_course_tables.R.
# PDF uses non-floating longtable so tables stay with their headings.
render_attainment_table <- function(df, widths, font_size = 9,
                                    align = NULL, merge_first_column = FALSE) {
    df <- as.data.frame(df, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df[] <- lapply(df, as.character)
    if (is.null(align)) align <- rep("l", ncol(df))
    stopifnot(length(widths) == ncol(df), length(align) == ncol(df))

    if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
        tab <- kableExtra::kbl(
            df, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE,
            row.names = FALSE, align = align, escape = TRUE
        ) |>
            kableExtra::kable_styling(
                latex_options = c("repeat_header", "striped"),
                stripe_color = "gray!10", font_size = font_size,
                full_width = FALSE
            )
        for (j in seq_along(widths)) {
            tab <- kableExtra::column_spec(
                tab, j, width = paste0(widths[j], "in")
            )
        }
        # Do not use collapse_rows for longtable: keeping rows intact
        # avoids incompatible multirow/float placement behavior.
        cat(as.character(tab), "\n\n", sep = "")

    } else if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {
        ft <- flextable::flextable(df) |>
            flextable::theme_booktabs() |>
            flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
            flextable::fontsize(size = font_size, part = "all") |>
            flextable::valign(valign = "center", part = "all") |>
            flextable::padding(padding = 4, part = "all")
        for (j in seq_along(widths)) {
            ft <- flextable::width(ft, j = j, width = widths[j])
            ft <- flextable::align(
                ft, j = j,
                align = switch(align[j], c = "center", r = "right", "left"),
                part = "all"
            )
        }
        if (merge_first_column && nrow(df) > 1L) {
            ft <- flextable::merge_v(ft, j = 1, part = "body")
        }
        ft <- flextable::set_table_properties(
            ft, layout = "fixed", opts_word = list(repeat_headers = TRUE)
        )
        flextable::flextable_to_rmd(ft)

    } else if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
        tab <- kableExtra::kbl(
            df, format = "html", row.names = FALSE, align = align
        ) |>
            kableExtra::kable_styling(
                bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE
            )
        if (merge_first_column && nrow(df) > 1L) {
            tab <- kableExtra::collapse_rows(tab, columns = 1)
        }
        cat(as.character(tab), "\n\n", sep = "")
    } else {
        cat(knitr::kable(df), sep = "\n")
        cat("\n\n")
    }
    invisible(NULL)
}

direct_levels_df <- data.frame(
    Level = c("1", "2", "3"),
    Internal = c(
        "<= 50% of the students secure 60% or more marks",
        "Between 50-60% of the students secure 60% or more marks",
        ">= 60% of the students secure 60% or more marks"
    ),
    External = c(
        "<= 50% of the students secure 50% or more marks",
        "Between 50-60% of the students secure 50% or more marks",
        ">= 60% of the students secure 50% or more marks"
    ),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_attainment_table(
    df = direct_levels_df,
    widths = c(0.60, 2.65, 2.65),
    font_size = 9,
    align = c("c", "l", "l")
)
```

### Attainment Level for Indirect Assessment {.unnumbered}

Employer feedback and student activities will be used alongside the graduate exit survey to achieve indirect PO attainment.

```{r}
#| label: indirect-attainment-levels-table
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

indirect_levels_df <- data.frame(
    Level = c("1", "2", "3"),
    Target = c(
        "<= 50% of the students attained the course outcome",
        "Between 50-60% of the students attained the course outcome",
        ">= 60% of the students attained the course outcome"
    ),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_attainment_table(
    df = indirect_levels_df,
    widths = c(0.60, 5.30),
    font_size = 9,
    align = c("c", "l")
)
```

### PO/PSO Attainment Methods and Tools {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: popso-attainment-methods-tools-table
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

popso_df <- data.frame(
    " " = c(
        "POs/PSOs Attainment",
        "POs/PSOs Attainment"
    ),
    "Assessment Method" = c(
        "Direct Method (80% weightage)",
        "Indirect Method (20% weightage)"
    ),
    "Assessment Tool" = c(
        "Course Outcome Attainment",
        paste(
            "Graduate Exit Survey, Employer Feedback,",
            "Co-curricular & Extra-Curricular Activities"
        )
    ),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Merge the first column in DOCX/HTML; PDF uses a non-floating longtable.

render_attainment_table(
    df = popso_df,
    widths = c(1.40, 1.80, 2.70),
    font_size = 9,
    align = c("l", "l", "l"),
    merge_first_column = TRUE
)
```
